title.text: The Vow of the First Keeper

contents.text: Carved into the lectern, the letters filled with old gold:
"I will look at all of it, always: the fields and the fen, the living and the lost. What is looked at is kept. What is kept is not lost."
Below, in a smaller hand: the Vale buried its dead here with their names said aloud, so the fen would remember them when the people could not.
